description: The company resolved the complaint by providing monetary compensation — a refund, fee reversal, credit, or other payment to the consumer.
The company resolved the complaint without a payment — e.g., correcting a credit report, releasing a lien, stopping collection calls, or fixing an account error.
The company closed the complaint with relief of an unspecified type. Treated as a positive outcome below the monetary/non-monetary split.
The company closed the complaint by explaining its position to the consumer without providing relief. The most common outcome in the CFPB dataset.
The company closed the complaint without providing any relief to the consumer.
The company closed the complaint without a documented relief category. Outcome quality is ambiguous.
The company failed to respond to the complaint within the regulatory timeframe. A negative signal for company risk scoring.
The complaint is still being worked and has no terminal outcome yet. Excluded from success-rate aggregations.
